summary: GET /api/assets/items/[id]/owners Get current owners of a misc asset
PUT /api/assets/items/[id]/owners Update owners of a misc asset (replace all owners)
GET /api/assets/items/[id] Get a single misc asset
PUT /api/assets/items/[id] Update a misc asset
DELETE /api/assets/items/[id] Delete a misc asset
POST /api/assets/items Create a new misc asset
GET /api/assets/items Get all misc assets for the authenticated user
GET /api/assets Get the active household's misc-assets summary — every item visible to any member, per H1 of the codebase review. Also uses integer-cents accumulation on totals.
PUT /api/budget/account-names/[id] Rename an existing account-number → name mapping.
DELETE /api/budget/account-names/[id] Remove an account-number → name mapping.

GET /api/budget/account-names/identifiers Returns the distinct payment identifiers found on the household's transactions, each with a transaction count and a sample payee name. Used by the settings UI to offer a pick-list so the user can recognize which account/card each opaque identifier belongs to
GET /api/budget/account-names List all account-number → name mappings for the household.
POST /api/budget/account-names Create a new account-number → name mapping for the household.
GET /api/budget/analysis Get budget analysis data for a date range: monthly totals, group/category breakdowns, tag spending
GET /api/budget/categories/[id] Get a specific category with transaction count
PUT /api/budget/categories/[id] Update a category
DELETE /api/budget/categories/[id] Delete a category (transactions become uncategorized)
PUT /api/budget/categories/merge Merge source category into target category. Moves all transactions, payees, rules, and Riseup mappings. Adds source budget to target budget. Deletes source category.
POST /api/budget/categories/reorder Bulk update sort orders for categories
GET /api/budget/categories Get all categories for the current household (optionally filtered by group)
POST /api/budget/categories Create a new category
GET /api/budget/categorization-logs Recent AI categorization queries for the household (newest first).
GET /api/budget/category-groups/[id] Get a specific category group with its categories
PUT /api/budget/category-groups/[id] Update a category group
DELETE /api/budget/category-groups/[id] Delete a category group (cascades to categories and their transactions become uncategorized)
POST /api/budget/category-groups/reorder Bulk update sort orders for category groups
GET /api/budget/category-groups Get all category groups with their categories for the current household
POST /api/budget/category-groups Create a new category group
DELETE /api/budget/cc-generic-payees/[id] Remove a generic CC payee name.
GET /api/budget/cc-generic-payees List all generic CC payee names for the household.
POST /api/budget/cc-generic-payees Add a new generic CC payee name for the household.
POST /api/budget/payee-rules/[id]/apply Apply a single rule to existing payees and their transactions. Updates payee default category AND re-categorizes existing transactions.
PUT /api/budget/payee-rules/[id] Update a payee category rule
DELETE /api/budget/payee-rules/[id] Delete a payee category rule
POST /api/budget/payee-rules/apply Bulk-apply all active rules to existing payees and their transactions. Updates payee default categories AND re-categorizes existing transactions.
GET /api/budget/payee-rules List all payee category rules for the current household
POST /api/budget/payee-rules Create a new payee category rule
GET /api/budget/payees/[id] Get a specific payee
PUT /api/budget/payees/[id] Update a payee
DELETE /api/budget/payees/[id] Delete a payee (transactions become orphaned payee-wise via SetNull)

GET /api/budget/payees Get all payees for the current household with transaction counts. Blacklisted payees are hidden by default; pass `?include=blacklisted` to return ONLY blacklisted ones (used by the Blacklist tab).
POST /api/budget/payees Create a new payee
GET /api/budget/reports/[month] — the full report for one cycle.

POST /api/budget/reports/continue { id } Internal: runs the next ≤300s step of a report's agent and hands off to a fresh invocation if it isn't finished. Answers immediately so the caller only waits for the acknowledgement. Protected by CRON_SECRET in production.

GET /api/budget/reports Months that have a report, newest first. Also the automatic recovery path: a report stuck in "generating" (its hand-off to the next run was lost) is resumed from its saved progress. The Budget layout calls this on every Budget page, so no extra cron is needed.

POST /api/budget/reports/run { month } Generate (or regenerate) the report for a closed cycle. The numbers are saved before this returns; the agent then runs in its own invocations (POST /api/budget/reports/continue), so the tab polls until it's ready.

POST /api/budget/riseup-categories/apply Re-apply Riseup category → budget category mappings to existing uncategorized transactions that have a riseupCategory stored on their payee or via a matching riseup category name.
GET /api/budget/riseup-categories Get all Riseup categories for the household (excluding deleted ones by default)
POST /api/budget/riseup-categories Bulk-create Riseup category records (skips already-known and deleted ones) Body: { categoryNames: string[] }
PUT /api/budget/riseup-categories Update mapping: assign a Riseup category to a budget category Body: { id: string, budgetCategoryId: string | null }
DELETE /api/budget/riseup-categories Soft-delete a Riseup category (won't be re-added on future imports) Body: { id: string }
GET /api/budget/savings Returns monthly savings data grouped by year
POST /api/budget/savings Create a savings transaction Body: { month: "YYYY-MM", amount: number }
PUT /api/budget/savings Update a month's savings (replaces all transactions for that month with one) Body: { month: "YYYY-MM", amount: number }
DELETE /api/budget/savings Delete all savings transactions for a given month Body: { month: "YYYY-MM" }
GET /api/budget/summary Get monthly budget summary with spending by category
GET /api/budget/tags/[id] Get a specific tag with transaction count
PUT /api/budget/tags/[id] Update a tag
DELETE /api/budget/tags/[id] Delete a tag (removes from all transactions)
GET /api/budget/tags Get all tags for the current household with transaction counts
POST /api/budget/tags Create a new tag
PUT /api/budget/tags/merge Merge multiple tags into one (move all transactions to target, delete sources)
GET /api/budget/transactions/[id] Get a specific transaction
PUT /api/budget/transactions/[id] Update a transaction
DELETE /api/budget/transactions/[id] Delete a transaction

POST /api/budget/transactions/[id]/suggestion approve → apply the AI-suggested category (categoryId = suggestedCategoryId) and make it this payee's default category (unless the payee is flagged neverDefault or blacklisted), so future transactions from the same payee are auto-categorized during inges
POST /api/budget/transactions/bulk Bulk create transactions (e.g., from import)
PUT /api/budget/transactions/bulk Bulk categorize transactions
PATCH /api/budget/transactions/bulk Bulk assign a tag to transactions (additive — existing tags are kept)
DELETE /api/budget/transactions/bulk Bulk delete transactions
POST /api/budget/transactions/dedupe-twins
POST /api/budget/transactions/import-csv Accept a Riseup CSV file upload (multipart/form-data), parse it server-side, and import the transactions. Enables programmatic uploads without the UI.
POST /api/budget/transactions/import Import transactions from Riseup CSV with payee resolution and category matching.
GET /api/budget/transactions Get transactions with optional filtering
POST /api/budget/transactions Create a new transaction
POST /api/budget/transactions/split Split a transaction into multiple transactions
DELETE /api/budget/transactions/split Unsplit a transaction (delete children and mark parent as not split)
GET /api/context Get the current user's context including profile, households, and household profiles

GET /api/dashboard/history Get net worth history data for the chart Uses database snapshots when available, falls back to generated mock data. Always appends a real-time "today" data point so the graph matches the dashboard cards.
GET /api/dashboard Get aggregated dashboard data: net worth from stocks, pension, and assets
DELETE /api/favorites/[id] Un-star a destination. There is no PATCH: favourites can't be renamed and ordering goes through /api/favorites/reorder.
POST /api/favorites/reorder Bulk-update the sortOrder of the current user's favourites. Drives the order in the favourites drawer, which reads them ordered by sortOrder.
GET /api/favorites The current user's favourites in the active household, in display order.
POST /api/favorites Star a destination. Body carries exactly one of `pageId` or `route`.

PUT /api/habits/[id]/log — mark one scheduled day Done / Not done, or clear it (`status: null`). Used by the page, the dashboard card and the notification's buttons (service worker, same-origin session cookie).
PATCH /api/habits/[id] — edit fields; `archived: true/false` archives or restores.
DELETE /api/habits/[id] — permanent, history included. Only from the archive.
GET /api/habits/logs?from&to — the user's answers in a calendar range (archived habits too).
POST /api/habits/reorder — `ids` is the full active list in its new order.
GET /api/habits — the signed-in user's habits. `?archived=1` lists the archive.
POST /api/habits — new habits go to the bottom of the list.
DELETE /api/households/[id]/invites/[inviteId] Revoke a pending invite. Admin only.
GET /api/households/[id]/invites List pending (unaccepted, unexpired) invites for a household. Admin only.
GET /api/households/[id] Get household details with members
PUT /api/households/[id] Update household (admin/owner only)
GET /api/households List all households the current user belongs to
POST /api/households Create a new household and add current user's profile as owner
DELETE /api/insurance/[id] Delete a specific insurance policy
POST /api/insurance/import Accept multipart file upload of Excel (.xlsx), parse it and import policies under the specified profile.
GET /api/insurance Returns all insurance policies for the household, grouped by profileId
POST /api/insurance Create a single insurance policy
GET /api/labs/dropped-transactions Returns recent drop-log entries for the active household — budget rows that were removed because their Moneytor row disappeared on a re-sync.
POST /api/labs/general-log/mark-read Marks all unread general-log entries for the active household as read. Called when the user opens the Activity page.
GET /api/labs/general-log Returns the active household's general log (rename events, hard-deletes, etc.), newest first, plus an unreadCount for the nav-badge dot.
GET /api/labs/general-log/unread-count Lightweight endpoint powering the nav badge dot on Labs. Returns the count of unread general-log entries for the active household.

GET /api/labs/sync-log Returns the active household's last N Moneytor sync attempts (manual + cron), newest first. The full MoneytorSyncSummary is included so the UI can break results out per section (transactions, accounts, portfolio, pension, real estate, etc.).
PATCH /api/moneytor/accounts/[id] Update editable per-account metadata. Today only `customSubtitle`, but structured to make it easy to add more fields (custom group, sort order, …).

GET /api/moneytor/accounts/history?range=1Y Daily timeseries of Moneytor account balances per (productId). Returns both `points` (aggregate balance per date — sum of all accounts) and per-account series so the dashboard can render sparklines.
GET /api/moneytor/accounts Returns the active household's Moneytor accounts (bank + debt for now), with per-form totals so the dashboard widget doesn't need to recompute.

POST /api/moneytor/force-resync Destructively re-pulls Moneytor transactions for a date range. Used when Moneytor has corrected upstream data and the upsert-based incremental sync doesn't surface the fix locally.
GET /api/moneytor/insurance Returns the active household's Moneytor insurance policies plus premium totals.

GET /api/moneytor/pension/history Returns monthly snapshots grouped by month, with per-type totals for charting. Each fund track has its own snapshot row per month — we sum per (month, productType) so the chart has one line per type.
GET /api/moneytor/pension Returns all pension + hishtalmut funds (no aggregation — one row per Moneytor route) with per-type totals.

GET /api/moneytor/portfolio/history?range=1Y Returns a per-day total value timeseries built from moneytor_stock_snapshots. Each point = sum of totalWorthInBase + accountCash across all snapshots on that date.

GET /api/moneytor/portfolio Returns Moneytor stock holdings in the PortfolioSummary shape consumed by /portfolio. All account totals are reported in ILS (Moneytor's base currency). Per-holding stockPrice and avgCostBasis are in the stock's native currency (rendered as bare numbers by the page), whil
GET /api/moneytor/real-estate Returns the active household's Moneytor real-estate properties, plus a total `balanceInBase` so the dashboard / assets page can show a summary without recomputing.
DELETE /api/moneytor/stocks/[productId]
GET /api/moneytor/stocks Returns all stock holdings synced from Moneytor for the active household, grouped by Moneytor account (productId/accountName).

POST /api/moneytor/sync Manual sync — pulls transactions + stock holdings from Moneytor for the active household. The same sync runs automatically once a day from the daily-tasks cron for every household.
GET /api/moneytor/transactions List Moneytor-synced transactions with filters.
POST /api/onboarding Complete the onboarding process for a new user Creates profile, household, and optional family member profiles
POST /api/pages/[id]/ops

GET /api/pages/[id]/share The owner's own read of the current share state (used by the Share dialog on open). Session-only — same reasoning as POST/DELETE below: the general `GET /api/pages/[id]` deliberately omits `shareToken` from its response (see that route) so a caller in via the scoped `AGENT_
DELETE /api/pages/[id]/share Turns sharing off. The old link stops working immediately — its token no longer matches any row.
PATCH /api/pages/[id]/tabs/[tabId] Partial update (title / content / sortOrder) — only keys the client sends are touched, so an autosave that sends just `{ content }` never clobbers the title.
DELETE /api/pages/[id]/tabs/[tabId] Removes a tab. Refuses to delete the last remaining tab — a page must always keep at least one.
POST /api/pages/[id]/tabs Create a new tab on a page. It sorts to the end; default title "Tab N".

GET /api/pages Lists the active household's pages, ordered for the sidebar (manual sort, then most-recently-updated). Content is omitted from the list to keep the payload small — the editor fetches a single page's content separately.
POST /api/pages Create a page. Owner = current user, household = active household. New pages sort to the top (sortOrder one below the current minimum).
GET /api/pages/sections Lists the active household's page sections, ordered for the Areas popup.
POST /api/pages/sections Create a section. New sections sort at the end of the list.

POST /api/pages/upload Uploads a single image (multipart form field `file`) to Vercel Blob and returns its public URL for embedding in a page. Requires a `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN` in the environment; without it we return a clear error the editor surfaces (and falls back to URL-embed).
GET /api/pension/accounts/[id]/owners Get current owners of a pension account
PUT /api/pension/accounts/[id]/owners Update owners of a pension account (replace all owners)
GET /api/pension/accounts/[id] Get a single pension account with its deposits (household-scoped).
PUT /api/pension/accounts/[id] Update a pension account (household-scoped write).
DELETE /api/pension/accounts/[id] Delete a pension account and all its deposits (household-scoped).
POST /api/pension/accounts Create a new pension account
GET /api/pension/accounts Get all pension accounts for the authenticated user
GET /api/pension/deposits/[id] Get a single deposit (household-scoped).
PUT /api/pension/deposits/[id] Update a deposit (household-scoped write).
DELETE /api/pension/deposits/[id] Delete a deposit (household-scoped).
POST /api/pension/deposits/bulk Create multiple pension deposits at once
POST /api/pension/deposits Add a new deposit to a pension account. The account must be visible to the caller's household (H1 of the codebase review).
POST /api/pension/parse-pdf Upload and parse a pension PDF file to extract deposit data
GET /api/pension Get the active household's pension summary — every account visible to any member, per H1 of the codebase review (pension is a household asset).
GET /api/portfolio/account-history?range=1Y
PUT /api/portfolio/accounts/[id]/cash/[cashId] Update a specific cash balance
DELETE /api/portfolio/accounts/[id]/cash/[cashId] Delete a specific cash balance
GET /api/portfolio/accounts/[id]/cash Get all cash balances for an account
POST /api/portfolio/accounts/[id]/cash Add or update a cash balance for an account If balance for currency already exists, it updates it
GET /api/portfolio/accounts/[id]/owners Get current owners of a stock account
PUT /api/portfolio/accounts/[id]/owners Update owners of a stock account (replace all owners)
GET /api/portfolio/accounts/[id] Get a single account with its holdings
PUT /api/portfolio/accounts/[id] Update an account
DELETE /api/portfolio/accounts/[id] Delete an account and all its holdings
POST /api/portfolio/accounts Create a new stock account
GET /api/portfolio/accounts Get all accounts for the authenticated user (without holdings detail)
GET /api/portfolio/holdings/[id] Get a single holding
PUT /api/portfolio/holdings/[id] Update a holding's quantity and/or cost basis
DELETE /api/portfolio/holdings/[id] Delete a holding
POST /api/portfolio/holdings Add a new stock holding to an account Also fetches and caches the current stock price from Yahoo Finance
GET /api/portfolio Get user's portfolio with all accounts and holdings
GET /api/profiles/[id] Get profile details
PUT /api/profiles/[id] Update profile (own profile or admin/owner can update non-user profiles)
DELETE /api/profiles/[id] Delete non-user profile (admin/owner only)
GET /api/profiles List all profiles in the active household
POST /api/profiles Create a non-user profile in the active household (admin/owner only)
POST /api/push — register this browser/phone for the household's notifications.
DELETE /api/push — stop notifications on this browser/phone.
POST /api/push/test { endpoint } — send a test notification to THIS device only.
GET/PUT /api/settings/report-prompt — the monthly report agent's prompt.

PATCH /api/settings/sync-aliases/[kind]/[id] Updates the user-defined canonical ID for a synced Moneytor entity. Empty string or null clears the alias. When set, the sync reconciler matches this row to any incoming payload whose stableKey equals this value — this lets the user manually collapse re-l

GET /api/settings/sync-aliases Lists every Moneytor-synced entity (bank/debt account, pension fund, real estate property) for the active household along with its current user-defined canonical ID + the auto-computed stableKey. The Settings UI uses this to let the user pin an alias so re-linked entri
PUT /api/shopping/cart/[id] Update a cart item (toggle checked, update quantity).
DELETE /api/shopping/cart/[id] Remove a single item from the cart.

POST /api/shopping/cart/deliver Mark the cart as delivered. Checked items are "delivered" (removed from cart, lastPurchasedAt updated), except for missingItemIds which stay in cart unchecked. Default items are re-added to the cart if not already present.
GET /api/shopping/cart Get all cart items with item name and category info. Ordered by category sortOrder then item name.
POST /api/shopping/cart Add an item to the cart. If already in cart, increment quantity.
DELETE /api/shopping/cart Clear all checked items from the cart.
GET /api/shopping/categories Get all shopping categories for the household. Auto-seeds default categories if none exist.
POST /api/shopping/categories Create a new shopping category.
PUT /api/shopping/items/[id] Update a shopping item's properties.
DELETE /api/shopping/items/[id] Delete a shopping item from the master list. Cascades to remove associated cart items.
GET /api/shopping/items List all shopping items with category info and cart status. Supports ?search= query param for case-insensitive filtering.
POST /api/shopping/items Create a new shopping item.
GET /api/shopping/warnings Get items where warningDays is set and the item hasn't been purchased within that threshold. Returns items that should be suggested for purchase.

POST /api/task-categories/reorder Bulk-update the sortOrder of task categories. The order set here drives the category order everywhere categories are listed (kanban grouping, pickers), since those all read categories ordered by sortOrder.

GET /api/task-categories Lists the household's categories. Token-reachable so an agent can discover the valid ids before referencing one on a task; every mutation below stays session-only, because there's no upsert-by-name and names are unique per household — letting an agent invent categories would

GET /api/task-tags Lists the household's tags. Token-reachable so an agent can discover the valid ids before referencing one on a task; every mutation below stays session-only, because there's no upsert-by-name and names are unique per household — letting an agent invent tags would just mean a strea

PATCH /api/tasks/[id] Session-only on purpose, like DELETE below. The scoped agent token's write surface is deliberately create-only: editing would let a token holder overwrite the title or notes of any task in the household, which is data loss without needing a delete verb. Widen this to `resolveTa

DELETE /api/tasks/[id] Session-only on purpose: `resolveTasksAccess` (and so the scoped agent token) deliberately does not reach here — destructive verbs stay behind a real browser session. Don't "tidy" this into the resolver like its GET/PATCH siblings. Same asymmetry as the Areas Pages routes.
GET /api/tasks Lists tasks in the active household that are visible to the current user (owned by them OR shared with them). Filters are optional query params.
POST /api/tasks Create a task. Owner = current user, household = active household. Enforces the one-level sub-task invariant (parent must be top-level).
DELETE /api/wiki/concepts/[id]/projects/[projectId] — unfile a source.
Single wiki concept — full read + editable fields + delete.
GET /api/wiki/concepts — list every concept in the active household. POST /api/wiki/concepts — create a manual concept (typically a Project). The LLM Source ingest lives at /api/wiki/sources.
POST /api/wiki/questions/[id]/attempt — record a radio-pick for scoring.
